Momcozy Smart WiFi Baby Monitor with Camera and Audio,5" 1080P & Wall Mount

Choose Between WiFi or Non-wifi Connections to Check on Baby Anywhere, Anytime: Use the dedicated BM04 baby monitor parent unit for reliable monitoring at home, or check the live feed via the Momcozy app while you're on the go. Advanced encryption ensures your baby monitor video is private and secure, so you can focus on your little one with peace of mind. Note: Pairing via Wi-Fi supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks.
Danger Zone Alert for Added Safety: Stay one step ahead with instant app notifications when your baby leaves a designated safe area. With this wifi baby monitor, you'll be alerted immediately so you can respond and keep them safe without delay.
